title: 1755: beyond Lisbon
hook: Was the tsunami’s reach confined to the damaged city?

predict.question: Did tsunami reports stop at Portugal’s coast?

frames.heading: Tagus
frames.text: A tsunami surges into the estuary.

frames.heading: Regional shores
frames.text: Waves damage Spanish and Moroccan ports.

frames.heading: Across the Atlantic
frames.text: Observers report waves in the West Indies.

reveal: Local destruction and ocean-wide effects are different scales of the same event. Reports place tsunami impacts around Iberia and Morocco and across the Atlantic in the West Indies. This map shows selected observations; it does not calculate wave heights, arrival times or a precise source fault.
limit: Later checkpoints group reports; their ordering is not a complete wave-arrival timetable.

sources.section: NOAA description: Lisbon, Tagus, Cádiz, Safi and West Indies
